sources.name: University of New Mexico Albuquerque Campus Planning
sources.use_after: Review the principal City, County, MRCOG/MRMPO, and NMDOT pathways, while promptly processing newly published UNM plans with direct Albuquerque transportation, development, mapping, or capital-project value.
included_record_classes: Albuquerque Safe Mobility Action Plan and implementation records
Integrated Campus Plan chapters and maps governing the Albuquerque campuses
Albuquerque campus transportation, bicycle, pedestrian, transit, parking, accessibility, and sustainability plans
Albuquerque campus maps, capital plans, facility plans, and major development projects
official project updates that materially connect UNM facilities with Albuquerque streets, transit, bikeways, or neighborhoods
excluded_by_default: routine events and news without durable planning value
student forms, parking notices, and temporary service advisories
limitations: Large design publications may have separate single-page and spread editions; prefer the smaller authoritative edition when content and fidelity are equivalent.
The Integrated Campus Plan includes branch campuses; only Albuquerque-relevant chapters and systemwide policies materially governing Albuquerque are in scope.
sources.verification_result: Official long-term planning page exposes the 2025 Safe Mobility Action Plan and adopted Integrated Campus Plan, with direct relevance to Albuquerque streets, bikeways, transit, campus development, and safety.

sources.name: Central New Mexico Community College Main Campus Planning
sources.use_after: Review the principal City, County, MRCOG/MRMPO, NMDOT, and high-value UNM pathways; process current CNM Main Campus plans and maps when they directly affect Albuquerque transportation, development, facilities, or public investment.
included_record_classes: Main Campus master plans and capital-project publications
Main Campus maps, transportation, parking, bicycle, pedestrian, transit, accessibility, and sustainability resources
major Main Campus construction, demolition, redevelopment, public-realm, and facility projects
systemwide CNM documents only when they identify material Main Campus projects or policies
excluded_by_default: Montoya, South Valley, Westside, and other non-Main-Campus projects unless the user expands scope
academic catalogs, curricula, and course material
routine board agendas and minutes unless they contain a unique adopted Main Campus plan or project record
procurement notices without durable planning or project information
student services, forms, events, employment, and temporary parking or construction notices
limitations: CNM uses systemwide publications that mix campuses; retain or extract only records with clear Main Campus relevance.
The interactive map requires rendered-browser validation.
sources.verification_result: Official CNM pages expose a current Main Campus map, interactive map, parking and transportation resources, and an FY2025 Master Plan Projects publication containing substantial Main Campus capital projects.

sources.name: City of Albuquerque OnBase Public Records Search
sources.use_after: Exhaust relevant City, Bernalillo County, MRCOG/MRMPO, and NMDOT pages, document hosts, sitemaps, catalogs, linked sources, and PDF lineage paths.
included_record_classes: other boards or commissions only when a clear transportation, planning, infrastructure, housing, or land-use connection is established
substantive Albuquerque Police Department annual reports and strategic plans relevant to ABQInfo
excluded_by_default: record classes without a demonstrated ABQInfo connection
limitations: Search-type menu appears incomplete and may not represent the City's full records holdings.
The interface is form-driven and should be queried narrowly rather than recursively crawled.
OnBase provenance does not replace a more direct official landing page or document source when one exists.
sources.verification_result: Public Records Search loaded and exposed board/commission, APD report, APD strategic-plan, and several unrelated administrative search types.
